title: SecurityHealthCheckResult - Data API
description: Stores Security Health Check results, including the baseline used and the score calculated.

BaselineApiName.description: The API name of the baseline used to calculate the Health Check score.

BaselineName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the Health Check result record.

ProcessedTime.description: The time when the Health Check score was calculated.

ResultDetails.description: The detailed information about the Security Health Check results.

Score.description: The Health Check score for the org. The score can range from 0 to 100.
